name: NOISE (Near Optimal IsoSurface Extraction)
definition: A rapid isosurface extraction algorithm for structured and unstructured grids that enables interactive, real-time changes to the isosurface threshold without full recalculation.
summary: NOISE is a rapid isosurface extraction algorithm that uses a K-D tree in span-space to efficiently identify candidate cells, enabling interactive real-time threshold adjustments without inspecting every volume cell.
